cards.card_text: Abishai son of Zeruiah, David's nephew (1 Chronicles 2:15-16), says, 'Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king?' I bet he's heard ENOUGH.
cards.verse_text: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head!”
